## Task: fix `call_command` with required mutually exclusive group kwargs (Django #11749)

**Cause** — `django/core/management/__init__.py`, `call_command()`: only actions with `opt.required` had their kwargs forwarded to `parse_args()`. Members of a *required mutually exclusive group* are individually `required=False` (the requirement lives on the group), so `shop_id=1` never reached the parser and argparse raised `Error: one of the arguments --shop-id --shop is required`.

```python
mutually_exclusive_required_opts = [
    action for group in parser._mutually_exclusive_groups
    for action in group._group_actions
    if group.required and action.dest in options
]
parse_args += [
    '{}={}'.format(min(opt.option_strings), arg_options[opt.dest])
    for opt in parser_actions if (
        opt.required or opt in mutually_exclusive_required_opts
    ) and opt.dest in options
]
```
